content: कुञ्जः, -जम् .²1 A place overgrown with plants or creepers, a bower, an arbour; चल सखि कुञ्जं सतिमिरपुञ्जं शीलय नीलनिचोलम् <ls>Gīt. 5</ls>; वञ्जुललताकुञ्जे <ls n="Gīt.">12</ls>; <ls>Me. 19</ls>; <ls>R. 9. 64</ls>. .²2 The lower jaw. .²3 A cave, <ls>Māl. 1. 3</ls>. (foot note). .²4 A tooth. .²5 The tusk of an elephant.
